releaseNotes:
Release v0.8.0

- Pair and reconnect using the selected scooter profile.
- Save multiple scooters of the same model with separate ride histories and parking spots.
- Choose from 17 phone-only profiles for GPS rides and parking.
- Move saved rides to Drift with an automatic import from earlier versions.
- Preview experimental Zest SmartXonnect speed and odometer telemetry. On-scooter validation is pending.
